msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed your e-learning and have referral paperwork, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option. Please bring referral paperwork signed by your PADI instructor.

The refresher is a separate one-day activity, so you’d do it the day before the referral course. It includes pool practice and one ocean dive. The referral course includes four certification dives over two days. You’ll need to stay overnight on the islands during the referral course; accommodation isn’t included. The refresher includes a return boat trip to Cartagena, so you’d need to travel back to Cartagena after it and depart again for the referral course the next morning.

The booking calendar lets you choose the dates and number of people.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access to diving, I recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—our dive base is at both, and pick-up is direct. Other nearby options with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Accommodation isn’t included in the diving plans, so you’ll book directly with the hotel.

For the refresher and courses, a medical form is required and is sent after booking. Would you like me to help you compare the Cartagena-departure and island-based options once you’ve chosen your dates?

Where would you be departing from? This plan takes several days and you need to *stay on the islands* (accommodation is not included): you can leave *from Cartagena* on the first day or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?
reply:
Yes—we operate every day of the year except December 25 and January 1, so Easter Sunday is normally an operating day. Trips can be suspended due to adverse weather.

The refresher is booked as a *Dive Mini Course*. From Cartagena, it’s *USD 183 per person online* (the online price includes the 10% discount), and it includes the boat, lunch, equipment, pool practice, and one ocean dive. Book and pay through the website here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, you can also book the island-based refresher for *USD 134 per person online*; it doesn’t include lunch or transport from Cartagena, and hotel pickup depends on maritime access: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

For April 5–6, choose the dates and number of people in the booking calendar. Your two-day *Open Water Referral Course* requires the referral form signed by your original PADI instructor. Would you like the booking link for that course too?

Which hotel or island are you staying at? That way we can arrange pickup.
